**GOLDEN-01 — FIRST REAL EXTERNAL APK RENDERS CORRECTLY (MASTER VISUAL COMPATIBILITY CAMPAIGN, EXT-01)**

Claim: `runtime-proven` + `visually-proven (structural)`. An externally released Android APK — NOT built by MiniAndroid — now loads, executes and renders with a correct visual result on this HEAD. Commit: `bcb3c1a5` (pushed, ls-remote verified).

**Fixture (Rule 1/2 compliant, frozen)**
- App: **HelloWorldSelfAware v1.1.0** by Appliberated (MIT) — release-built APK artifact, never regenerated
- Source: https://github.com/Appliberated/HelloWorldSelfAware (tag v1.1.0 → commit `9526576`)
- APK SHA-256: `009b467109c4d48d4b00610b06f37f3a77eed75178fbaae344a111acc848cc41` (120,512 bytes, v1+v2 signed)
- Package `com.appliberated.helloworldselfaware`, versionCode 2, minSdk 9 / targetSdk 35, launchable `MainActivity`
- Component hashes: manifest `cb8f4606…`, classes.dex `1bd71b2a…`, resources.arsc `46192960…`
- Candidate inspection record: hardcodedjoy/android-app-hello-world REJECTED (no released artifact) → Appliberated SELECTED
- Trusted reference (no emulator/KVM in this environment → Rule 11 option 3): the author's own published phone screenshot, SHA-256 `121d479c…`

**G08 baseline on the SAME untouched HEAD (honest FAIL)**: default screen (black band + white), `setContentView` → `root_id=0 views=0`, `findViewById` → null, `setText` → `""` — screenshot preserved at `docs/evidence/external_hello_golden/baseline_g08_broken.png`

**Four real root causes fixed (all reproduced independently, Rule 5):**
1. **DEX `encoded_value` size law (CRITICAL spec bug, dex_parser.cpp)** — `value_arg` means "bytes − 1" (AOSP art/libdexfile); readers consumed `size_arg` bytes, so every 4-byte R constant lost its top byte (`0x7f030000` → `0x030000`). Name-mediated lookups stayed self-consistent (masking the bug for in-house fixtures); ID-mediated lookups broke. After fix: SGET values `0x7f050002`-class, inflation `views=0 → views=1`.
2. **Virtual device identity** — `Build.VERSION.SDK_INT/RELEASE`, `Build.*`, `Settings.Secure.ANDROID_ID` were unseeded (0/null → "i'm null"). Seeded honestly (SDK_INT=34/RELEASE="14" per android-34 stub toolchain; deterministic ANDROID_ID) + `Settings$Secure.getString` + `getContentResolver` handlers (AOSP laws).
3. **Context/Activity.getString(int, Object...)** — Activity fell through the bridge (8 failed dispatch attempts → empty text). Added per AOSP inheritance law; formatArgs applied through the ONE canonical `java_format_walk` engine (extracted verbatim from CYCLE-E String.format — REUSE-FIRST).
4. **Theme windowBackground** — manifest `android:theme(0x01010000)` → ARSC style bag (map keys NOW RETAINED — parser discarded them) → `android:windowBackground(0x01010054)` → `@color/colorPrimary` → `#000000` painted behind content (PhoneWindow law). White text was invisible on the white default surface before.

**Runtime evidence (all from the real APK bytes; JSON sidecar ABSENT — `resource_values.json loaded=false`)**
- Chain: APK → ZIP/EOCD → binary manifest → ARSC (`strings=4 colors=4`) → AXML layout inflate (`root_id=4 views=1`) → DEX `MainActivity.onCreate` → `findViewById` → `getString(0x7f050002, fargs=3)` → `"hello world\ni'm 6f1c3a9d2e5b4780\na version 14 android\nwith api level 34"` → TextView → theme background → font render → PNG 1080×1920
- Screenshot: `docs/evidence/external_hello_golden/miniandroid_frame1.png` SHA-256 `65f6980b65120b1895f8219378f1586a11f1de6e528b2902b495d7e56d7a89be`
- Determinism (Rule 12): 3 independent runs byte-identical
- Structural comparison vs the phone reference (Rule 10, honest): background identical black ✓ 4-line ink-band structure ✓ horizontal centering exact (540.0/1080) ✓ vertical centering ✓ — 6/7 checks; the open 7th is typography: relative text width 0.383 vs 0.642 of screen and line spacing → font pipeline gates G31–G48 queued next. Device-specific strings (ANDROID_ID/version/API) differ by design.

**Regression at this HEAD (zero-skip, all re-run from the fixed tree)**
- helloworld_golden validator 26/26 (golden SHA `87820741…` unchanged)
- tictactoe_golden validator 8/8
- MUTF-8 battery 14/14
- semantic 14+25+57 = 96/96

**Not claimed**: pixel-identity to the phone reference (different device content + typography gap), GOLDEN-02 (interaction), GOLDEN-03. Full gate record: `docs/evidence/GOLDEN01_EXTERNAL_HELLO_GATE_RECORD.md`.
